title: ManyBabies 1: robust infant-directed-speech preference as successful-control replication record
summary: Promotes ManyBabies 1 as a successful-control record. The record is deliberately included to keep the failed-replication lane honest: multi-lab replication can also preserve a robust effect while narrowing its magnitude and boundary conditions.

status_history.note: Promoted or created in rev0012 multi-lab replication / boundary-map pass.

handling_notes: Avoid turning replication into researcher humiliation or field dismissal.
